tex_content.html:
Remark
[Ricci flow and metric topology] ↗ def:epsilon-close-topology

Closeness of metric families in this sense imposes no time-derivative bound. For Ricci flows, $C^{2k}$-closeness is equivalent to control of the $r$th time derivatives of the $s$th covariant derivatives whenever $s+2r\le 2k$.
